name: ESC throttle range over the parameter link: accepted range, read-back, failure reasons
step: Check the ESC parameter transaction behind the Setup Wizard's ESC link range
rationale:
The Setup Wizard can set the throttle range on a YGE ESC over the parameter link, as the EdgeTX suite does. A
write to the ESC is only trusted when its block reads back with the same values, because the ESC may refuse a write
without saying so. The range the ESC accepts is also fixed by the codec's own limits.

The harness drives lib/esc_params.lua against a simulated ESC and pins: the accepted range (zero 900..1900 us, span
600..1500 us, a start above 1000 us), a write confirmed by read-back, and the reasons a write ends with when the read,
the write, the read-back or the order fails.

--self-test drops the read-back and requires the silent refusal to go red.
